How Tourists 'Escaping the Heat' May Drive Future Increases in Municipal Water Demand in Oregon Coastal Communities
abstract: Little is known about the effect of future weather and climate on municipal water demand in coastal communities with tourist-centric economies. To address this knowledge gap, we used an econometric model of monthly water demand that allowed for non-linear responses to weather variables to estimate temperature-response functions for demand from a sample of communities in the Oregon Mid-Coast. A main result is that local temperature was not a significant driver of variability in monthly water demand but that temperature in the Willamette Valley – the source of most tourists to the Oregon coast – was. We assumed that the increase in demand in response to higher Willamette Valley temperature arose from an increase in tourists escaping the heat in the Willamette Valley for cooler conditions on the coast. Applying the temperature response functions to scenarios of future climate to the year 2070 led to projected increases in water demand independent of other factors. Whether future tourism is either constrained by the local resident population that serves tourism or is constrained by the potential tourist population in the Willamette Valley, the climate-change contribution to projected water demand is generally of comparable magnitude to – if not greater than – the contribution from resident population change alone over the next fifty years. For communities where the population is projected to decline, the climate effect may more than offset the effect of declining population, resulting in a net positive change in demand.
abstract_zh: 关于未来天气和气候如何影响以旅游业为核心的沿海社区的城市用水需求，人们所知甚少。为填补这一知识空白，我们使用一个允许对天气变量作非线性响应的月度用水需求计量模型，从俄勒冈中部海岸的一组社区样本中估计了用水需求的温度响应函数。主要结果是，当地温度并非月度用水需求变化的显著驱动因素，但威拉米特河谷的温度却是。威拉米特河谷是俄勒冈海岸游客的主要来源地。我们假设，威拉米特河谷温度升高所引起的用水需求增加，源于更多游客为逃避当地炎热而前往气候较凉爽的海岸。将温度响应函数应用于2070年的未来气候情景，结果显示，在不考虑其他因素的情况下，用水需求将出现增长。无论未来旅游业是受到服务旅游业的本地常住人口的制约，还是受到威拉米特河谷潜在游客人口的制约，在未来五十年内，气候变化对预计用水需求的贡献，通常与仅人口变化所带来的贡献处于相当的量级，甚至更大。对于人口预计将减少的社区，气候效应可能超过人口减少的影响，从而导致需求出现净正增长。

title: Integrating Oceans into Climate Policy: Any Green New Deal Needs a Splash of Blue
abstract: Recent warnings from scientists suggest there is limited time to enact policies to avert wide‐ranging ecological and social damage from climate change. In the United States, discussions about comprehensive national policies to avert climate change have begun, with “Green New Deal” proposals and climate plans put forth by members of Congress and presidential candidates. Oceans are largely absent or separate from these nascent policy proposals. Here, we highlight a policy framework to develop terrestrial and ocean‐integrated policies that can complement and enhance terrestrial‐focused initiatives focused on four specific sectors: 1) energy; 2) transportation; 3) food security; and 4) habitat restoration. Given political friction and constrained budgets, an integrated policy framework offers greater potential to achieve a portfolio of mitigation and adaptation goals in a cost‐effective manner, beyond what could be realized with marine or terrestrial policy solutions alone.
abstract_zh: 科学家近期发出警告，表明我们留给政策行动的时间有限，以避免气候变化造成的大范围生态与社会损害。在美国，关于全面国家气候政策的讨论已经开始，国会议员和总统候选人提出了“绿色新政”提案和气候计划。然而，海洋在这些初步的政策提案中基本缺席，或与之相分离。本文提出了一个政策框架，旨在制定陆地与海洋相融合的政策，以补充并强化以陆地为中心的倡议，涵盖四个具体部门：1）能源；2）交通；3）粮食安全；4）栖息地恢复。鉴于政治摩擦和预算约束，相较于单独依靠海洋或陆地的政策方案，一个综合性政策框架更有潜力以成本有效的方式实现减缓与适应目标的组合，其效果超出仅靠单一领域政策所能实现的范围。

title: The Deep Sea and Me: Using a Science Center Exhibit to Promote Lasting Public Literacy and Elucidate Public Perception of the Deep Sea
The Effects of Weather on Recreational Fishing Demand and Adaptation: Implications for a Changing Climate
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Outdoor recreation is one of the most popular leisure activities in the United States, yet the potential impacts of climate change on the nonmarket aspects of this activity are largely unknown or poorly understood. We estimate the nonlinear effects of temperature and precipitation on the demand for a significant segment of the outdoor recreation economy—shoreline marine recreational fishing in the Atlantic and Gulf Coast regions—from 2004 to 2009. Our econometric estimates suggest that extreme heat significantly reduces recreation participation. We find declines in participation (up to 15%) and welfare (up to $312 million annually) over a range of predicted climate futures. These impacts vary spatially and temporally, with warmer locations and times of year experiencing significant losses and gains possible in cooler areas. We also find evidence of climate-averting behavior as anglers shift their activities to nighttime rather than fish less frequently to mitigate the negative impacts from extreme heat.
abstract_zh: 户外休闲是美国最受欢迎的休闲活动之一，然而，气候变化对这一活动非市场方面的潜在影响在很大程度上尚不明确或理解不足。我们估算了气温和降水对户外休闲经济中一个重要组成部分——2004 至 2009 年大西洋和墨西哥湾沿岸浅海海岸休闲钓鱼需求——的非线性影响。我们的计量估计表明，极端高温会显著降低休闲参与度。在一系列预测的气候情景下，我们发现参与度下降（最高可达 15%），福利损失（每年最高可达 3.12 亿美元）。这些影响在空间和时间上存在差异，较温暖的地点和季节将出现显著损失，而较凉爽的地区则可能出现收益。我们还发现了气候规避行为的证据：垂钓者将活动转移至夜间，而非减少垂钓频率，以减轻极端高温的负面影响。

Are there Efficiency Gains from the Removal of Natural Resource Export Restrictions? Evidence from British Columbia
abstract: Log export bans (LEBs) are a popular development tool utilised by developing nations with sizable endowments of timber; however, the actual impact of these policies is debatable. British Columbia has a developed forestry sector and still maintains a LEB. This trade restriction continually creates conflicts with Canada's international trade partners, including the United States. This paper examines the efficiency implications of a hypothetical removal of roundwood export restrictions in British Columbia using roundwood price and quantity data from 1995 to 2008. A time‐series econometric approach is utilised to determine supply and demand elasticities for British Columbia's roundwood. Empirical results from a vector error correction model suggest that a removal of export restrictions will generate an overall increase of approximately $347.91 million US dollars per year to British Columbia's forest economy.
abstract_zh: 原木出口禁令（LEB）是拥有丰富木材资源的发展中国家广泛采用的发展工具；然而，这些政策的实际影响仍有争议。不列颠哥伦比亚省拥有发达的林业部门，但仍维持着原木出口禁令。这一贸易限制不断引发与加拿大国际贸易伙伴（包括美国）之间的冲突。本文利用1995年至2008年的圆木价格和数量数据，考察了假设取消不列颠哥伦比亚省圆木出口限制的效率影响。我们采用时间序列计量方法，确定了该省圆木的供给和需求弹性。误差修正向量模型的实证结果表明，取消出口限制将为不列颠哥伦比亚省的林业经济带来每年约3.4791亿美元的总体增长。
